summary: Frontend testing of iteration 3 features: inline SVG mascots (Ojos vivos + Platos reveladores) and new top-down dish photos. All features verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). 5 worlds (egeo/tirreno/levante/oriente/magreb) — note the review mentioned 'adriatico' but no such world exists in /app/frontend/src/data/worlds.js; the real 5th world is 'oriente'. All 5 world mascots render as inline SVG (role=img, aria-label). Legacy /img/d_*.webp and character .webp are fully gone (0 occurrences). No 4xx/5xx on any /img/ response; all top_* images have naturalWidth>0.

critical_code_review_comments: parts.jsx useLook adds a global pointermove listener per mascot instance; with 10+ mascots on a page each binds its own handler. Consider a shared context/global listener for perf, especially on mobile (currently guarded by hover:hover MQ, so OK).
Reveal.jsx picks the character line with d.id.length % lines.length — deterministic per dish, fine, but limits variety; consider rotating index per open.
DishDrawer showImg = d.img && (!d.variants || variantId === 'V01') correctly handles the ORI-DISH-02 V02 photo-hide case.
No DishCard forwardRef warning fix shipped since iteration_2; still logs 'Function components cannot be given refs' via AnimatePresence PopChild (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: localStorage key 'orilla-mesa' cleared before each run
context_for_next_testing_agent: The review request mentioned a world 'adriatico' which does NOT exist in the data (worlds.js has: egeo/tirreno/levante/oriente/magreb). All 5 real worlds render inline SVG mascots correctly on landing hero worlds, cast, carta hero pickers, carta world heads, and dish reveal. Ojos vivos works: pupils translate on pointermove, eyes have scaleY blink wrapper. Mouth switches to 'wow' ellipse on mascot hover. Platos reveladores: Reveal.jsx orchestrates cloche lift (0.6s delay, 0.7s duration), mascot spring-up from bottom (0.1s delay), sparkles at 0.8s, bubble + present=true at 650ms. ORI-DISH-02 V02 correctly swaps photo→price sticker. No image 404s. All iteration_2 flows remain in place (dish-drawer, dish-drawer-title, dish-drawer-close, dish-variant-V02, dish-food-notice).
